title: Tabbed Organizer — Settings as a layered, tabbed file system — Qwen 5.8

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Tabbed Organizer keeps the left-shell canon and replaces the settings interior with a layered-sheet + domain-tab stack; category tabs, edge tabs, and roster+detail sheets are concept-native compositions, not canon changes.
No taxonomy change; the 12 inventory categories render as domain tabs and edge tabs with stable ids for deep links. Legacy global-scope metadata stays provenance-only (see plan-owner-delta.md).

Providers roster + detail tabs answer the six default questions first (connected, account, models, usage-end, routing, setup); credentials never raw; installations show selected/shadowed; update ask-first and rollback states demonstrated.
Servers / Server Claim / Remote Access / Full Server backup remain deferred named-owner shells rendered as setup cards with insertion + return contracts; no backend state machine invented.
Hosting, Sync/Move, and App & Content Updates deferred shells shown; Copy Settings remains one-time transactional with restore point and rollback.
Onboarding shell card links first-run flow; return contract selects the new provider connection and issues a continuation receipt.
All long actions (install, update, probe, cleanup, index rebuild) run through PMState2 beginOp/advanceOp/finishOp; determinate only with denominators; no permanent spinners.

settings_inventory_impacts: No id changes; concept routes use inventory category/subgroup ids verbatim (#/cat/<cat>/<sub>?row=<id>).
All 828 rows reachable via subgroup tabs and the virtualized #/all compendium with faceted filters.
settings_schema_impacts: Row value-state vocabulary reused from shared atoms (default/custom/managed/unavailable/restart/reconnect/changed-elsewhere); concept adds no new schema fields.
Search result types (setting/manager/managed_object/action/setup/diagnostic/unavailable) rendered as chips; routing strictly by rid.
command_id_impacts: See candidate-command-delta.json (census against Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md; reuse/alias/candidate only, provisional).
wiring_impacts: See candidate-wiring-delta.json; every control traces UI→command-candidate→owner→validation→mutation→receipt→projection→recovery; demo state marked simulated.
dry_component_impacts: See candidate-dry-delta.json; headless data/search/state/copy/row atoms reused from _shared; presentation is concept-native; DRY Method family demonstrated with visible reuse state.
schema_event_storage_impacts: Receipts, restore points, and recent-changes persist per concept via PMState2; no new storage schema proposed.
Family-local manager row edits are demo-local (famState) and receipted; they do not touch the 828-row inventory.
migration_supersession_impacts: Supersedes legacy collective-coverage rule: this concept individually demonstrates all 42 required families.
Supersedes scope-selector legacy: no Global/Project/Goal/Host selector, no inheritance, no profiles/sync UI anywhere.
Retheme supersedes paper/binder/folder skeuomorphism of the Tabbed Organizer reference: layout kept, visuals PM tokens only.
slint_port_impacts: Theme via data-theme on <html> across 8 themes; reduced motion via data-reduced-motion kills all concept animations (sheet slide, tab underline).
Width tiers via #app[data-wtier]; squeezed/narrow collapse to one-pane push stack with horizontal roster strip; wide adds bounded context pane (max 75ch text).

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: First-run flow reuses provider/account/installation records; no duplicate secret store.
Explicit install from official source per Host/Environment inside provider Installations tab.
Claim handshake binds server record before hosted work is offered.
Human-language cards under System & Advanced; deep-link slot reserved for server shell.
Source Location card (Hosted On, Project Files, Run Work) plus sync status slots.
Pairing/session approvals; auth browsing stays human-only.
Relocation/sync bundles owned by sync pipeline; Settings surfaces status + entry points.
Host-scoped signed PM updates separate from provider/LSP/container updates.
Server backup class beside settings/project backup with own schedule + verification.

unresolved_questions: Whether edge tabs (home right rail) should persist into domain views in a production port.
Canonical tab order for provider detail tabs versus the six-question overview default.
demonstrated_families: All 42 required families demonstrated concept-natively; 9 deferred named-owner shells rendered with insertion + return contracts.
